note: Adapted from Emerson's English original description of 1943, there named Kalotermes milleri, new species; type locality Elliott Key, Florida (holotype queen, morphotype soldier, paratypes king and soldier, collected by E. M. Miller on 7 February 1942 (month 2)), with further records from Key Largo (Florida) and from Bluefields Bay, Jamaica (20 May 1941, month 5, decaying stump) and Portland Ridge (3 May 1941, month 5, dead standing timber). The description is based on 8 reproductives and about 37 soldiers. The species is named after E. M. Miller.

sections.label: Diagnostic characters
sections.text: The smallest species of Kalotermes (s. str.) in the continental United States. The alate paratype of the Cuban K. bequaerti has longer wings, is yellow rather than dark brown, and has distinctly larger compound eyes; the soldier paratype of that species has a proportionally wider pronotum and straighter mandibular apices (the original notes that this difference may not hold in a long series).

sections.label: Alate
sections.text: Head, pronotum and abdominal tergites dark lustrous brown; labrum yellow; sternites slightly paler than the tergites; femora, tibiae and tarsi pale yellow; the anterior margin of the wing and the radius brown, the wing membrane transparent. Head and pronotum with scattered setae and hairs; the posterior parts of the tergites and sternites with a few short hairs and long setae. Head oval, the Y suture indistinct. Compound eyes rather small and slightly angular, their distance from the lower margin of the head about two thirds of their long diameter. Ocelli touching the compound eyes or separated only by a fine brown line. Antennae 13-segmented, segment 3 equal to or slightly shorter than segment 2 and about equal to or slightly longer than segment 4. Pronotum about as wide as the head, the median length about three fifths of the width, the sides slightly rounded, the anterior margin evenly concave, the posterior margin slightly concave. At rest the fore wing scale covers the base of the hind wing scale. In the fore wing the subcosta merges with the anterior margin near the wing suture; R1 absent; R2+3 a single branch, reaching the anterior margin a short distance beyond Sc; R4+5 with about 6 upper branches; M weaker than the radius, running between the radius and the cubitus; Cu emerging near the wing apex, with numerous lower branches. Anal vein of the hind wing rather thick. Arolium present between the claws. Measurements (mm): length including the wings 7.52—7.76; head width 0.84—0.93; diameter of the compound eye 0.22—0.27; distance of the compound eye from the lower margin 0.15—0.18; ocellus length 0.09—0.11; pronotum length 0.51—0.59; pronotum width 0.80—1.00; hind tibia length 0.68—0.76; fore wing length 5.92—6.10; fore wing length from the suture 5.26—5.37; fore wing width 1.29—1.30.

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text: Head and body pale yellow, the anterior part of the head and the mandibles contrasting dark brown to black. Head, pronotum and tergites with several scattered setae. Head long, the sides slightly curved or nearly parallel; a thick, conspicuous dark ridge above the antennal base, and a pale eye spot behind the antennal base. Postmentum about half or less than half as wide in the middle as in front, the sides evenly concave from the widest point to the posterior end. Mandibles slightly curved along the outer margin at the base, incurved at the apex; left mandible with 3 marginal teeth, the margins of teeth 2 and 3 wavy and together forming a symmetrical marginal outline; right mandible with 2 conspicuous marginal teeth of about equal size. Antennae 10—11-segmented, segment 3 about twice as long as segment 2 and darker than the outer segments. Pronotum proportionally long, the sides rather straight, the anterior margin angularly concave, the margin slightly upturned to receive the back of the head and sometimes flaring where it meets the sides, the posterior margin evenly convex. Femora inflated, tibiae rather short and thick, less than half as wide as the femora; apex of the tibia with 3 thick dark spines. Measurements (mm): head length including the mandibles 2.21—2.71; head width 0.94—1.12; postmentum maximum width 0.41—0.49; postmentum minimum width 0.16—0.23; left mandible length 0.91—1.06; pronotum width 0.92—1.06; pronotum median length 0.56—0.79; hind tibia length 0.71—0.88.
